reported_success.quote: After a second stage of data collection (the pooled sample size was powered at 90% to detect 50% of the original effect size), we replicated the treatment effect. Our findings are thus in partial agreement with those of the target study

notes: Primary-paper titles verified against supplied references. Selected the focal veracity-by-treatment interaction independently on both sides. Original locator p.4 is coarse and does not align with the published Study 2 result on p.776; study, outcome and test identify the target. Replication locator p.5 is coarse; exact HTML section and paragraph supplied. Requested original standardized beta is not explicitly identified as standardized in the text, so metric preserves printed β without asserting standardization. Requested replication d is not printed for the focal regression interaction: retained printed β with its own p=.017. The treatment-only d=−0.14 and control-only d=−0.10 describe within-condition truth discernment, not the interaction. A separate participant-level discernment comparison prints d=−0.10, t(1581)=−2.013, p=.044; it is a different test and is not substituted. Stage 1 focal regression β=0.0046, p=.67, n=701; Stage 2 pooled result is used as final replication. Authors report Stage 1 unsuccessful, Stage 2 replicated with attenuation, and partial agreement overall; coded mixed. Stage 2 p is uncorrected for the two-stage process, as explicitly reported. No conversions performed. Full papers acquired via Europe PMC XML after DOI landing pages returned 403; PDF page verification route also returned 403 and was not retried.
